## Strategic Notes

### Hard Blockers

- Pure HCI without composition focus
- AI use without disclosure per Elsevier policy

### Soft Tax

Low for composition / rhetoric tradition.

### Best Suited For

- Writing pedagogy research
- Digital rhetoric studies
- Multimodal composition
- Digital literacy research
- AI and writing instruction

### Not Recommended For

- Pure HCI (consider TOCHI)
- Pure linguistics (consider Computational Linguistics)

### Rejection Fallback Chain

| Rank | Journal | Why this fallback works |
|------|---------|------------------------|
| 1 | *(College Composition and Communication — community contribution welcome)* | 4Cs/CCCC flagship |
| 2 | [Cultural Studies ↔ Critical Methodologies](../qualitative-methods/cultural-studies-critical-methodologies.md) | If critical-rhetoric focus |
| 3 | [Qualitative Inquiry](../qualitative-methods/qualitative-inquiry.md) | If qualitative-methodology dominates |

**Reverse direction** *(optional)*: If your paper was rejected from CCC as "too technology-focused," Computers and Composition is the Elsevier digital-rhetoric home.
